input: lets do onboarding docs agent instructions blog etc for the general way for humans to contribute to this repo. basically replicating my process.

task: Contributor onboarding: CONTRIBUTING.md, the owner's steering process for people, an agent runbook for human requests, agent doc and post from run-record data

doc_friction.issue: Site URL is /monorepo-projects/ here and in build.mjs DEFAULT_BASE_URL, but /oss-monorepo/ in CLAUDE.md and portfolio/hosting/README.md:343; portfolio-pages.yml builds /oss-monorepo/ when vars.PAGES_BASE_URL is unset. Could not tell which is live from a session.
wall_minutes median is 3.4 for scheduled runs, implausibly low for runs that open and merge a PR; may cover only part of a transcript. Not used in the write-ups.

The first user message was interrupted before any work; the follow-up 'how did this go?' arrived two days later with main ~340 PRs ahead. Nothing in the docs covers resuming an interrupted session; the new human-requests.md runbook now says to check what actually landed first.

Searched open PRs for contributing/onboarding at the start and found none, then PR #9956 (another session, same topic, CONTRIBUTING.md) opened and merged while this one was writing. A search only at the start misses a parallel session; searching again right before opening the PR would have caught it.
PR #9958's base-URL move updated BASE but not the regex that detects an existing link, turning main's Pages tests red; fixed here.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: reading ~2,600 run records and the prompt system, then writing five docs and a counting script by hand

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
